media.title: Joe May — portrait (Die Herrin der Welt, 1919)
media.description: Joe May, Austrian-German film director and producer, in a cropped detail from a 1919 cast-and-crew photograph for Die Herrin der Welt (The Mistress of the World).
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait of Joe May, cropped from a 1919 film cast-and-crew photograph.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Cropped detail of a 1919 production photograph for Die Herrin der Welt; published before 1929 (public domain in the United States) and over a century old. Via Wikimedia Commons.
